profile.name: Amar Sinha
profile.title: Assistant Professor & Ph.D. Researcher
profile.affiliation: ITM University Raipur & IIIT Naya Raipur

publications.title: iDecide: Leveraging Deep Learning to Enhance Seamless Handover Decisions in B5G Networks
publications.abstract: Proposes iDecide, an intelligent deep-learning framework integrated with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) to eliminate handover failure rates and the Ping-Pong effect in multi-tier Beyond 5G mobile networks. Demonstrates sub-millisecond decision latency and 99.4% handover prediction accuracy.

publications.title: dGuard: Real-Time Detection of Driver Drowsiness and Stress Using YOLOv12 and Mediapipe
publications.authors: S. Barik, G. Sahu, S. Verma, A. Sinha, Mallikharjuna Rao K.
publications.abstract: A computer-vision and edge-AI framework combining YOLOv12 facial landmark detection with MediaPipe mesh analysis for ultra-reliable, real-time drowsiness and cognitive stress classification in smart automotive cockpits.

publications.title: A Quantum-Enhanced Semantic Communication Framework for Securing Military Health IoT Data
publications.authors: A. Agrawal, R. Verma, A. Sinha
publications.venue: 10th IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing and Communication (ICSC)
publications.abstract: Presents a quantum-enhanced semantic compression and encryption protocol tailored for tactical and battlefield telemedicine IoT systems, achieving 80% bandwidth compression with provable quantum resistance.

publications.title: Liver Disease Classification by Analysing Salient Features of LFT: An Explainable ML Approach
publications.authors: A. Agrawal, T. Sen, A. Sinha, P. Gangopadhyay
publications.venue: IEEE International Conference on Interdisciplinary Approaches in Technology and Management (IATMSI)
publications.abstract: Introduces an Explainable AI (XAI) clinical diagnostic system analyzing Liver Function Test (LFT) biomarkers using SHAP and LIME interpretations to empower medical practitioners with transparent decision rationales.

publications.title: AnDet: ML-Based Anomaly Detection of UEs in a Multi-cell B5G Mobile Network for Improved QoS
publications.authors: A. Sinha, A. Agrawal, S. Roy, V. Uduthalapally, D. Das, R. Mahapatra, S. Shetty
publications.venue: IEEE International Conference on Computing, Networking and Communications (ICNC)
publications.abstract: Presents AnDet, an unsupervised machine-learning anomaly detection framework identifying rogue or degraded User Equipments (UEs) in dense B5G topologies, preserving overall Quality of Service (QoS) and radio resource efficiency.

publications.title: SDN-Based Seamless Mobility Management for B5G Services in High-Speed Railways
publications.authors: A. Sinha, V. Uduthalapally, D. Das, R. Mahapatra
publications.venue: IEEE International Conference on Advanced Networks and Telecommunications Systems (ANTS)
publications.abstract: A seminal SDN-driven mobility architecture for high-speed trains (350+ km/h) operating across Beyond 5G mmWave networks. Features proactive flow-rule pre-caching on OpenFlow switches to achieve zero handover drop rates.

publications.title: Leveraging CSI of WiFi for Breath Estimation: An RNN-Based Rate Computation Using ESP32 Data
publications.authors: M. Sharma, A. Sinha, D. Das, R. Mahapatra
publications.abstract: Harvests raw WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) subcarrier amplitudes via low-cost ESP32 microcontrollers. Feeds time-series variance through a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to estimate human respiratory rates without wearable contact.

patents.title: AI-Driven Post-Quantum Cryptographic Key Management System
patents.authors: S. Vollala, S. Mazumdar, S. Banerjee, S. N. Mishra, K. Sahu, A. Sinha
patents.abstract: An intelligent, lattice-based post-quantum cryptographic key distribution and dynamic re-keying mechanism governed by reinforcement learning for multi-party secure communications resistant to quantum Grover and Shor attacks.
